periods.time: October, during the extended summer break before second term

name.zh: 十月的KOK动向与婚礼准备
name.en: October KOK News and Wedding Preparations

periods.location: Hagun Academy, Haneda Airport, and Vermillion
periods.summary: Ikki reflects on his journey, hears postwar career news from Kagami, and travels to Vermillion where he and Stella prepare for their wedding and new future.
periods.cause: After the summer's crises, Hagun's break is extended, Ikki has recovered enough to train, and his and Stella's families have arranged the wedding while both have also qualified for KOK A-class.
periods.process: Ikki trains alone at Hagun and revisits memories from meeting Stella through Seven Stars. Kagami tells him he and Stella will debut in KOK A-class by recommendations from multiple countries; Kurono is returning to A-class, Nene is training, Moroboshi is entering National Defense University through Itsuki's recommendation, and Amane may return to Seven Stars. Kagami explains that reporting survivors moving toward tomorrow is her journalism creed. Ikki then boards a Vermillion royal jet to join Stella, who is wearing a wedding dress for fitting and portrait preparations.
periods.outcome: Ikki acknowledges that he must stop using self-denial as his main fuel and accept the value others see in him. He and Stella walk slowly together toward their wedding, closing the Worst One's story and opening their shared future.
periods.significance: Transitions Ikki and Stella from student-competition protagonists to adult A-class knights and spouses, while surveying the next paths of major student knights.
